body:
I met some folks who still hadn’t heard about the Children, Youth, and a New Kind of Christianity conference in Washington, DC, May 7-10. Do you know people who work in kids ministry or youth ministry who might want to be there?

The complete list of presentations, workshops, and panels for the conference has been released at http://children-youth.com/2012/03/24/full-list /.

Will you help us make this historic gathering a success by sharing this link with three people who might be interested in attending? And if you haven’t registered yet, head to http://children-youth.com/register and sign up before registration closes on April 25.
